channel.title: Defensive Pedal updates
channel.description: What changed on defensivepedal.com and in the Defensive Pedal cycling navigation app: new figures, new pages, new platforms.

item.title: Homepage validation figure aligned with the published study
item.description: The homepage and llms.txt now state the validation result the way the open-access study does: about twice as many serious injuries per ride on streets rated High risk as on streets rated Safer. The earlier "1 in 5 million vs 1 in 2 million" card is retired. Same change on the Romanian homepage.

item.title: Question-style headings and a cross-page links block on every page
item.description: The homepage, privacy policy and terms now use question headings ("How does Defensive Pedal pick your route?", "Who is responsible for your data?"), open with a one-sentence definition of the app, and end with a links block to every page in both languages plus this feed. Same changes on the Romanian pages.

item.title: Methodology page: how the risk score works and how it was validated
item.description: The seven factor families behind the 100+ risk factors, the data sources, and the validation against crash records at 2,034 sites in five countries: serious-injury rate rises with each risk level, about twice as high on the highest-risk streets. Links the open-access analysis on Zenodo. Also in Romanian at /ro/methodology.

item.title: Privacy policy and terms of use published in English and Romanian
item.description: Full GDPR privacy policy and consumer terms for the app and website: what the app collects and why, retention periods, processors, GDPR rights, Premium billing and the 14-day withdrawal right. Romanian versions at /ro/privacy and /ro/terms.

item.title: Homepage figures updated: 3,984 installs and ETSC 2026 road safety data
item.description: Install count updated to 3,984 across Android and iOS as of October 2026. Safety context now cites ETSC PIN Flash 50 (2026): cyclists are 10% of all people killed on EU roads, 1,926 in 2024, and cyclist deaths fell 8% between 2014 and 2024 while deaths of drivers and passengers fell four times faster.

item.title: European Cycling Risk Ranking of 117 cities linked from the site
item.description: A ranking of 117 European cities by modelled cycling risk, built from the same street-level safety model that powers the app, with a contact block for municipalities on the homepage.

item.title: Defensive Pedal launches on the iOS App Store
item.description: The app is now available for iPhone alongside Android. Safety routing is free on both platforms.
